title: My favourite place
instructions: Aylin en sevdiği yeri anlatıyor. Neden sevdiğine ve ne zaman gittiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: aylin
script.text: My favourite place is a small beach near my grandparents' village.

script.speaker: aylin
script.text: It isn't famous, so there are never many people there.

script.speaker: aylin
script.text: The water is clear and quite cold, even in August.

script.speaker: aylin
script.text: When I was a child, I went there every summer with my cousins.

script.speaker: aylin
script.text: We swam all day and ate watermelon under the trees.

script.speaker: aylin
script.text: Now I live in the city, but I still go there for a week every year.

script.speaker: aylin
script.text: It's the best place to relax.

questions.prompt: Why are there never many people at the beach?
questions.feedback: Ünlü değil (It isn't famous), bu yüzden kalabalık olmuyor.
questions.evidence: It isn't famous, so there are never many people there.

questions.prompt: Who did Aylin go there with as a child?
How long does Aylin go there now?
questions.feedback: Şimdi her yıl bir haftalığına (for a week) gidiyor.
questions.evidence: I still go there for a week every year.
